facts.fact: The paper 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?' is authored by Amal Doua.
The paper was published in the Journal of Interdisciplinary Science Topics on March 30, 2017.
The study investigates whether Hiccup could supply enough fish to maintain the diet of Toothless, a Night Fury dragon.
It was found that Toothless would have required 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon daily, totaling 716 kg over twelve days.
Hiccup would have needed to carry 828 fish weighing a total of 8592 kg over the twelve days, which is deemed unrealistic.

Toothless is a Night Fury dragon who appears in the How to Train Your Dragon (HTTYD) franchise, and is said to be the rarest, fastest, and most intelligent of the dragon species. In the 2010 film, Toothless is struck down during a dragon raid and loses his left tail-fin, leaving him trapped in a sunken area. This paper investigates the feasibility of Hiccup, a teenage boy, being able to supply enough fish to maintain the dragon’s diet by catching and bringing fish to him. It was found that in the twelve days that Toothless was trapped, he would have required 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon every day, which totalled 716 kg. Hiccup would have had to carry 828 fish weighing at total of 8592 kg over the twelve days, which is unrealistic since he struggles to lift a shield in combat. [...] Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III, the main protagonist, is a small teenage boy eager to prove himself as a Viking. Using an invention which closely resembles a net gun, Hiccup strikes down Toothless during a dragon raid. Toothless’ left caudal fin is severed, rendering him unable to fly out of the sunken area, known as The Cove . Fish are a large component of a dragon’s diet, and Toothless is exclusively dependent on fish for nutrition . This paper investigates whether Hiccup is able to maintain Toothless’ feeding habits while he is trapped in The Cove.
